sloka: प्राप्ते यूपः उच्छ्रये तस्मिन् षड् बैल्वाः खादिराः तथा ।तावन्तो बिल्व सहिताः पर्णिनः च तथा अपरे ॥१-१४-२२॥
transliteration: prāpte yūpaḥ ucchraye tasmin ṣaḍ bailvāḥ khādirāḥ tathā ।tāvanto bilva sahitāḥ parṇinaḥ ca tathā apare ॥1-14-22॥

translations.english: All these posts were prepared by knowers of sastras and by those wellversed in the performance of sacrifices. They were decorated with gold to add elegance to the sacrifice.
